title: Composer
responsibility: Collects a comment or agent request and sends it through the appropriate parent callback only when its mode and prerequisites permit submission.

inputs.name: Composer.modes
inputs.description: Ordered modes allowed in this context: comment, plan or change. Uses the first mode initially and whenever the previously chosen mode is no longer offered. An empty list disables entry and submission. Shows mode buttons only when more than one mode is offered.

inputs.name: Composer.providers
inputs.description: Provider choices passed to the agent controls for Plan and Change. Submission of either agent request requires a non-null agent choice; comments do not use these providers.

inputs.name: Composer.approved
inputs.description: Whether Change is permitted for the current design. False disables its mode button and blocks Change submission, even when Change is the only offered mode. Does not block Plan or Comment.

inputs.name: Composer.running
inputs.description: Whether work is already running. True disables the message box and submission in every mode; it does not itself disable mode or provider selection.

inputs.name: Composer.notice
inputs.description: Optional hint shown in the non-agent layout, empty by default. A nonempty value replaces the ordinary comment hint. It is not displayed while Plan or Change is selected.

inputs.name: Composer.placeholder
inputs.description: Optional message-box prompt for Plan and Change, empty by default. Empty uses “Describe the next design…”. Comment uses “Leave a comment…” regardless of this value.

inputs.name: Composer.visual
inputs.description: Optional flag, false by default. A visual Plan includes the device setting for the number of design options in its request. Change and Comment never include that count.

inputs.name: Composer.compact
inputs.description: Optional flag, false by default, enabling the compact composer styling and compact agent pickers.

inputs.name: Composer.comment
inputs.description: Required asynchronous callback for submitting trimmed comment text. A true result clears the text; false leaves it available for retry. The component does not catch a rejected promise or display a callback error.

inputs.name: Composer.send
inputs.description: Required asynchronous callback for Plan and Change. Receives trimmed text, request mode, provider, model and effort, plus the design-option count for a visual Plan. A true result clears the text; false preserves it. Rejected promises are not caught here.

outputs.name: Composer
outputs.description: Message form with permitted mode choices, agent controls for Plan and Change, and a send button. Blocks submission without a mode, with blank text, while running, without an agent choice for a request, or for an unapproved Change. Loads device agent settings on mount. Comments use the comment callback and never start an agent through this component.

dependencies.contract: The shared Select component supplies keyboard and value selection behavior through the $shared alias.
